newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservatives to study Labour spending promises.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservatives to study Labour spending promises.

text.p: Britain's chief secretary to the Treasury William Waldegrave said on Thursday he was costing Labour's pre-election spending promises and would publish the results later this year.
"We are costing all the promises whch Labour has put on the record and I will be publishing the results later in the autumn," he told a fringe meeting at the Conservative Party Conference.
"It will for the first time give an indication of the big increases in taxes that New Labour would have to make to meet their spending commitments."
He said the judgement would be based on careful study of Labour's speeches and policy documents.
"(Labour leader Tony) Blair made 20 explicit spending commitments in his Conference speech. There are dozens more in Labour's speeches and policy documents."
